text:
maria: quick check — i'm pulling together the latency vs cost narrative cards for next week's webinar and social launch. thinking 3 short cards + 1 hero chart. want feedback on which angles land.
elaine: love the 3-card approach. what are you envisioning for the hero chart? p95/p99 vs $/k tokens? :thinking_face:
matt: +1 on p95 or p99 vs cost. also include an explicit example: 'how batching cuts cost for chat workloads' with a tiny before/after stat.
ryan: can we avoid 'perplexity' nerd math in marketing? keep it customer-first: "latency that feels instant vs dollars saved at scale."
zoe: for the cards: 1) immediate latency wins (user-facing latency), 2) unit economics (cost per 10k tokens), 3) reliability fallbacks (graceful degradation lanes). each needs a 1-line hook + CTA.
maria: draft hooks: 
- "Responses that feel instant — keep product flows snappy"
- "Cut inference spend by 30-60% at scale"
- "Stay online during traffic spikes with smart fallbacks"
Thoughts?
ashley: shortcopy tweaks: second one maybe "Reduce inference spend up to 60% as you scale" (avoid hard promises). also need a supporting stat footnote for the 30-60%.
matt: agreed on softer phrasing. for footnote we can say "based on internal benchmark across open models with batching + kv cache" and link to the eval doc.
marketing-bot: link added: https://docs.redwood.ai/benchmarks/latency-cost-2026 (view-only)
ryan: chart ask: hero should be a small-multiples grid: left column = latency (p50/p95/p99) by model variant, right column = unit cost ($/10k tokens) by same variant. color-code hosted vs dedicated vs private.
zoe: can we add a simple before/after micro-scenario for a chat app: "1000 daily active users -> 10k daily messages" with numbers for cost & p99 latency? that helps PMs translate to their product.
maria: yep — i'll mock one micro-scenario. question for ops: how do we want to route webinar signups who click 'benchmark details'? tag as "benchmark-interest" and route to SDR queue? @ashley
ashley: yes — tag = "benchmark-interested", route to 'sdr-bench' workspace queue. also add a checkbox for 'private deployment interest' to surface enterprise leads.
matt: copy for the webinar CTA: "Join our live demo + deep-dive: real benchmarks, model tradeoffs, and a Q&A on routing & SLAs" — keep it technical but approachable.
zoe: visuals: request 3 variants of the hero chart — clean line grid, bar small-multiples, and a one-slide animation showing batching lowering cost over time. we'll test in the webinar and social.
maria: timeline: slides + hero art by Wed, landing page + form by Thu, social cards by Fri. i'll upload drafts to the doc. please react if you can take a slot to review Wed morning.
ashley: i'll own the routing/leadflow config. +1 to Wed review.
ryan: i'll vet the micro-scenario numbers and add a conservative range.
elaine: i'll review hooks and CTAs, and add A/B copy variants for the landing page.
marketing-bot: reminder set: review meeting 2026-05-06 10:00 PT. :bell:
maria: thanks team — i'll post the first mock later today and drop the link here. :sparkles:
